# `aitbc system logs`

Show journalctl logs for a systemd service.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc system logs [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--service` | text | — | yes | Service to show logs for |
| `--lines`, `-n` | integer | `50` | no | Number of log lines to show |
| `--since` | text | — | no | Only entries newer than this journalctl time spec (e.g. '10 min ago') |
| `--grep` | text | — | no | Filter entries with this journalctl --grep pattern (max 200 chars) |
| `--priority`, `-p` | text | — | no | journalctl -p priority filter: a level name/number (err, warning, 3) or a range (err..warning) |
| `--severity-pattern` | flag | `false` | no | Filter on app-level severity text (WARN/ERROR/CRITICAL) — app logs carry no journal priority |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc system logs --service <service>
```
